verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs claim you can write docs alongside collections and publish them as shareable HTML (bruno-docs-20). This is backed by a rich-text docs editor (bruno-docs-12) and AI-assisted writing in the Docs tab (bruno-docs-53). However, the publishing claim is a single tagline with no detail on how the output is generated, hosted, or kept in sync. missing for 10: documented publish/export workflow details, generation from OpenAPI specs, hosting/sharing options, independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTML publishing.
